info.name: Get transfer volume for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: List of chains to filter by. If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query transfer volume for.

items.docs: Returns transfer volume snapshots for the specified address, broken down by chain.

info.name: Get transfer volume for an entity

params.name: chains
params.description: List of chains to filter by. If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity ID to query transfer volume for.

items.docs: Returns transfer volume snapshots for the specified entity, broken down by chain.
